response.sql: WITH event_averages AS (SELECT e.event_name, AVG(b.amount) AS average_amount FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event GROUP BY e.event_name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_amount) AS overall_average FROM event_averages), kept AS (SELECT ea.event_name, ea.average_amount, o.overall_average FROM event_averages AS ea CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE ea.average_amount > o.overall_average), kept_average AS (SELECT AVG(average_amount) AS average_of_kept FROM kept) SELECT k.event_name, k.average_amount, k.average_amount - k.overall_average AS difference_from_overall, k.average_amount / ka.average_of_kept AS ratio_to_kept_average FROM kept AS k CROSS JOIN kept_average AS ka
